actions.defeat: The company cannot continue without its protected companions.

dialogue.text: The monastery is on the hill to the north. Get me there, and I can use its wards to clear this fog.

alternative.speaker: Storm mage
alternative.text: The monastery is on the hill to the north. Its wards can help us clear this fog. Get one of us there.

actions.log: A mage identifies the northern hill monastery as a way to clear the fog.

say.speaker: The company
say.text: The stones answer the mage’s touch. The mist is bound here; three uninterrupted turns in the circle can break it. Shapes stir among the trees below.

dialogue.text: Keep them back. I need three turns here to break the veil.

alternative.speaker: Storm mage
alternative.text: Keep them back. I need three turns here to break the veil.

actions.log: The hill ritual begins; skeletal wolves emerge.

say.speaker: The company
say.text: The fog thins and lifts. The keep and the burial grounds lie exposed below.

actions.log: The hill ritual clears the valley’s fog.

objective.label: Hold the monastery with a mage for three turns

say.text: More names for the bell.
You’ll have no more of them.

actions.log: A voice carries across the valley.

dialogue.text: It's a raising rite. The bell is bound to the marked stones. Anyone left on them when it tolls will be killed and raised for its master. Get the prisoners clear—cutting their bonds won't be enough.

alternative.text: Those marks are part of whatever that bell is doing. Get the prisoners clear of them. I'm not leaving anyone there to find out what happens when it rings.

actions.log: The company recognizes the danger of the ritual marks.

say.text: A church beyond the trees. The door is open.

actions.log: The eastern church comes into view.

say.speaker: The company
say.text: A shirt of mail beneath the bench. No rust, and silver runes worked into the links.
Take what we can use. Leave the door unbarred for anyone coming after us.

actions.log: Enchanted mail is found in the eastern church.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Here! Please—before it rings again!

actions.log: The northern prisoners have been found.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Our hands are free. Where do we go?
Off the marked stones. Stay clear of the fighting.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Here! Please—before it rings again!

actions.log: The eastern prisoners have been found.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Our hands are free. Where do we go?
Off the marked stones. Stay clear of the fighting.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Here! Please—before it rings again!

actions.log: The southern prisoners have been found.

say.speaker: Captive
say.text: Our hands are free. Where do we go?
Off the marked stones. Stay clear of the fighting.
Bring them back. Alive or dead—their blood will serve the ritual just the same.
Did you think the mist would hide you from me? My toll is still unpaid. I'll have it in bones.
Behind us. Keep the company together—we're not turning back.

actions.log: The Tollkeeper's skeleton patrol enters from the southwest.

say.speaker: The company
say.text: The graves stand open. The first toll reached these prisoners before we did.

actions.log: The northern graves have already opened.
The bell tolls across the valley.
The bell tolls across the valley.
The bell tolls across the valley.

actions.victory: Mission complete. The company can rest and regroup.

say.speaker: Reinforcements
say.text: Captain! Your runner reached the ferry. We followed your trail.
Good timing. Join the company—we need to silence that bell.

actions.log: Reinforcements from the ferry arrive from the west.

dialogue.text: The connection broke. I’ll have to start again.
